canonical_reuse.scope: The same exact finite-multiset relation and empty/singleton specialization through the existing shared six-field Genco helper for both validation families. Full larger-list multiplicity fallback retained.

deductive_argument: Equality of finite multisets implies both count relations. Conversely, the expected-driven relation matches the count of every expected equivalence class. Their counts sum to len(E). Equal total lengths give len(A)=len(E), leaving no actual element outside those matched classes. Thus every class has equal multiplicity. Empty lists and duplicates are included. No runtime assumption is introduced.

exact_cardinality_specialization.empty: For E=[] finite multiset equality holds exactly when A=[]. Return actual.is_empty().
exact_cardinality_specialization.larger: For every expected length>=2 retain equal total lengths and every exact expected equivalence-class count. No cardinality limit or unsupported branch is introduced.
exact_cardinality_specialization.side_conditions: The existing pure derived Eq and valid finite slice conditions remain unchanged. No field, duplicate, assertion, cover, input or unwind reduction.
exact_cardinality_specialization.singleton: For E=[e], finite multiset equality holds exactly when A=[a] and a==e. Slice patterns enforce the complete cardinalities, then use the same full ValidationError Eq once.

law_conditions: Finite valid slices of ValidationError records.
ValidationError derives Eq over its kind/path/optional bad-value/detail fields; the combined six-field variant additionally compares Origin and the declarative flag.
Eq is an equivalence relation; comparisons have no user-visible side effects. Iterator counts fit usize for valid finite slices.
new_relation: len(A)==len(E) and for every e in E, count_A(e)==count_E(e)
old_relation: len(A)==len(E) and for every a in A, count_A(a)==count_E(a)
ordinary_controls: Independent input-ID histograms for all 1600 pairs of lists of lengths 0 through 3 over three distinct full six-field records, alongside existing permutation, duplicate, length and all-six-field mutations. Bounded native regression evidence, not a general Kani theorem.
preserved: All five feature and all twenty-five general source harness bodies, fixtures, actions, assertions, covers, domains and unwind bounds remain unchanged. Shared matching compares all six fields. Production bodies and constructor-image mapping remain unchanged.
